name: Office Rules
source:
Office Rules is a story-driven visual novel where your choices shape relationships and influence how the story unfolds.

Chris has recently been transferred from working remotely to the company's office. Around the same time, a Project Manager position becomes available, and he recommends his girlfriend, Emily, for the job. 

There's just one problem. 

The company has a strict policy that forbids romantic relationships between employees. To keep Emily's new job safe, they agree to pretend they've never met whenever they're at work. What starts as a simple plan soon becomes something much more complicated. 

Every conversation, every decision, and every encounter can change the course of their relationship.​

Itch.io: https://red-bloom-studio.itch.io/officerules
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/RedBloomStudio
